physics-killer-03.title: Mushando nekushandurana kwe mechanical energy
physics-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-03.material: Chinhu chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinotsvedza chichibva mukupera kwenzvimbo isina friction yakakotama pakukwirira $4\,\mathrm{m}$, chichipfuura nzvimbo yakaoma yeplane yakachinjika (kureba $5\,\mathrm{m}$, friction force inoshanda pachinhu yakaenzana $11\,\mathrm{N}$) uye chinokwira pamusoro peinclined plane isina friction kuruboshwe. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ uye kuramba kwemhepo kusingatariswe, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wethermal energy $Q$ inoitika munzvimbo yakaoma uye maximum height inosvikwa pamusoro peinclined plane yezasi zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Chinhu chine huremu $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ chinotsvedza chichibva mukupera kwenzvimbo isina friction yakakotama pakukwirira $4\,\mathrm{m}$, chichipfuura nzvimbo yakaoma yeplane yakachinjika (kureba $5\,\mathrm{m}$, friction force inoshanda pachinhu yakaenzana $11\,\mathrm{N}$) uye chinokwira pamusoro peinclined plane isina friction kuruboshwe. Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ uye kuramba kwemhepo kusingatariswe, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wethermal energy $Q$ inoitika munzvimbo yakaoma uye maximum height inosvikwa pamusoro peinclined plane yezasi zvichitevedzana?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Mechanical energy yepakutanga $E_0=mgh_0=2\cdot10\cdot4=80\,\mathrm{J}$. $Q=fs=11\cdot5=55\,\mathrm{J}$ inova kupisa munzvimbo yakaoma, saka mechanical energy yasara ndi $80-55=25\,\mathrm{J}$. Sezvo inclined plane isina friction, kubva $25=mgh$ pa $h=\dfrac{25}{2\cdot10}=1.25\,\mathrm{m}$. Kutora friction kusingaiko uye kukwira kusvika $4\,\mathrm{m}$ ndiyo nhema ②, kutora simba rasara $25\,\mathrm{J}$ sekupisa ndiyo nhema ③, kushandisa $mgh$ pachinzvimbo che $\frac12mgh$ kunopa $2.5\,\mathrm{m}$ (nhema ④).

physics-killer-03.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

Kana $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ uye kuramba kwemhepo kusingatariswe, ndeupi mubatanidzwa wakarurama wethermal energy $Q$ inoitika munzvimbo yakaoma uye maximum height inosvikwa pamusoro peinclined plane yezasi zvichitevedzana?
